product.name: Soundcore Boom 2 Plus Portable Bluetooth Speaker by Anker, 140W, IPX7 | 2+2 Channel Audio, BassUp 2.0, 20H Playtime, Fast Charge, RGB Lights, Power Bank, Bluetooth 6.0, Camping and Beach Use
features: 140W Max Booming Bass: Feel the power of the bass in every song with dual woofers for depth and clarity. And with BassUp 2.0, the output is boosted from 100W to a staggering 140W max—that's 160% more than the first generation of BassUp.
2+2 Stereo Clarity: Dual 50W woofers and dual 20W tweeters deliver crisp highs and deep lows, balanced by smart crossover technology for an immersive audio experience.

30W Fast Charging and Built-In Power Bank: Pair with a 30W charger to fully charge Boom 2 Plus portable speaker in just 3 hours and keep the beats playing for 20 hours. And with the built-in power bank, you can give your phone and other essentials a 10W charge wherever you are. (Playtime may vary based on volume level and playback content.
IPX7 Waterproof and Floatable: Boom 2 Plus portable speaker is designed to handle any adventure so you can listen with no worries at the beach, by the pool, or in the rain.

Your Sound, Your Way: Boom 2 Plus outdoor speaker lets you fine-tune your audio with customizable pro EQ so every song hits just right. With the upgraded Auracast, you can link multiple speakers to flood any space with immersive sound.
